issues: The evaluator loses correlated proposals during clarification. It retains only the currently processed statement, drops other products' terms, and can narrow an all-products proposal to the current product. A proposal with no usable terms can also become an invented promise after entering scope or date clarification.

Confirmation corrections with an omitted product reference do not resolve against readback_ids. Even when only one product was read back, the evaluator asks unnecessarily or later uses the stale negotiation focus.

Extraction fields can contradict one another: c_event=proposal with c1_kind=paid and payment terms silently becomes a paid disposition. Refusal, payment, dispute and proposal statements need consistency checks before any state mutation.
reject() prefers stale amount/date values over the offer actually rejected. Later attempts can therefore repeat a rejected offer or reject the wrong terms.

The vague-date rule is not followed when the clarification receives yes, unknown or a non-answer without a date. The evaluator may spend persuasion attempts instead of proposing the deadline. Date parsing also mishandles ordinary cardinal day expressions and lacks a semantic period classification independent of a short phrase list.

Callback validation waits for both date and time before recognizing an independently invalid component, contrary to Brief A rule 7. It asks for already supplied components and ignores AI and scam questions during callbacks.
A swapped-date hint followed by the requested month word can leave the original, swapped day unchanged and submit another wrong answer.
The required paid-payment explanation disappears when finish() routes through add_note: its local speech prefix is not preserved across the tool result.
Declining hardship support overwrites previously resolved paid/disputed products and valid pending promises with hardship.

Caller-first AI and scam questions are discarded before the first name question. Collection questions are always answered with 'I do not have that information', even when the requested amount, product or days-late information is present in the account response.
Existing checks do not cover these failures across clarification, result re-entry and the next reply. This review is static; neither code checks nor actual dialogue were executed.

patches.value: A supplied day or time that is independently outside the permitted window consumes an invalid proposal, even if the other component is missing. Ask once for another time; a second invalid proposal closes not_reached/no_callback.
Retain valid supplied components and ask only for the missing date or time. Answer AI or scam questions before continuing. Do not submit an incomplete callback.

Ask once for the exact day of an unresolved vague proposal, retaining its products, amounts, other statements and period context across paraphrases. If the clarification still supplies no exact day, propose each affected product's deadline. An unrecognized or conflicting exact-date representation remains unresolved and is clarified rather than silently replaced. A resolved proposal ends that clarification episode.

Static source and code audit only. The local checks prescribe extraction values and reachable intermediate states; they have not been executed and do not demonstrate actual extraction, routing, speech or dialogue success. No tools were called. No usable synthetic test identity was supplied, so smoke is omitted; individual-brief mode omits scenarios.

Wait after the exact initialized utterance. No tool call is allowed. Permitted questions ask when the named customer can be reached or ask only for a missing callback date or time. The computed speech may first answer an AI question by identifying Freya Bank's digital assistant, or a scam question by referring to Freya Bank's customer service number without inventing that number. Do not disclose the purpose, discuss account information or accept a relative's security answers. An independently invalid proposed day or time counts against the one-alternative allowance even when the other component is missing.

The initialized speech is the entire authorized utterance. Wait for the fresh answer; no tool call is allowed. Permitted questions ask whether the customer accepts the stated agent-proposed amount/date, request an exact payment day, clarify a product reference or conflicting statement, offer support after hardship, ask once whether you may help before a human transfer, or ask 'Do you confirm?' after the collective read-back. Computed speech may answer questions using the loaded product, amount, days late, floor or deadline. Never ask how much the customer can pay. Never independently repeat or invent an offer. Retain every product and unchanged term through clarification and confirmation corrections. Do not continue identity questioning. Recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled; changes belong in the mobile app.

Classify only the newest reply. A proposed or corrected date/amount is proposal or correction, even when incomplete; never classify it as no/nonanswer. Historical closure/payoff is dispute; paid means payment of the current past-due amount. Hardship is illness, family death or job loss and takes precedence over a simultaneous plan request; retain voluntary terms in their correlated slots. nonanswer means an actual irrelevant response with no payment terms. unknown means unresolved meaning or extraction, not refusal. yes/no answer the question actually asked. none means no fresh reply. Slot kinds must agree with the act: paid/dispute/refused slots have no proposed payment amount/date. A proposal may contain separate promise and refused/paid/dispute statements for different products, but its payment terms must remain in promise slots.

value.name: c1_date_form
value.description: Semantic form of c1_date, without resolving its calendar value. period means a genuinely vague period or event such as sometime next week, once wages arrive, around payday or later this month; use this by meaning, not a phrase whitelist. exact names a complete day; incomplete supplies a day, weekday or other fragment requiring earlier context; unknown is uninterpretable or conflicting. none when c1_date is absent. Do not call an unsupported exact spelling a period.

value.name: c2_date_form
value.description: Semantic form of c2_date only, using the same definitions as c1_date_form. Preserve this statement's own date and scope. none when absent.

value.description: Semantic form of c3_date only, using the same definitions as c1_date_form. Preserve this statement's own date and scope. none when absent.

value.name: c_question
value.description: Only for a question in the newest reply: classify the requested account fact. Put an explicitly spoken product reference in c1_ref with c1_kind=none and empty amount/date. Do not infer runtime IDs or account values. other means information outside these categories; none when no question.
